name: The Denver Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Denver Post's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and Ad Fontes rates it Middle (-2.86). Neither rates the editorial board separately.

name: The Gazette editorial board (Denver Gazette and Colorado Springs Gazette; one board, two mastheads)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Denver Gazette's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and does not rate the editorial board, which writes for both the Denver and Colorado Springs Gazettes.

name: The Colorado Sun
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Colorado Sun Lean Left (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). The nonprofit newsroom has no editorial board and does not endorse.

name: Denverite (Colorado Public Radio)
lean_basis: Colorado Public Radio's Denver newsroom calls itself 'a member-supported news organization for the curious and concerned in our ever-changing city' (https://denverite.com/about-denverite-staff/) and does not endorse. No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of Denver
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that says 'The League is strictly nonpartisan' (https://lwvdenver.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Denver Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its home page lists its 2026 endorsed candidates (including the at-large council race) and its Denver and statewide measure positions.

name: Colorado Working Families Party
lean_basis: Minor party that calls itself 'a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful' (https://workingfamilies.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Denver Democratic Socialists of America
lean_basis: Self-described socialist group: 'a local chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America, the largest socialist organization in the United States' (https://denverdsa.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Denver Area Labor Federation (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: AFL-CIO labor federation for metro Denver whose officers are 'dedicated to represent the interests of working people at the state and local level' (https://denverlabor.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation whose stated focus is 'building power for working people and fighting for a fair and just economy for all' (https://coaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Regional chamber of commerce (https://denverchamber.org/about/); chambers map to lean_right (business climate, lower regulation and taxes). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Downtown Denver Partnership
lean_basis: Business group that says it is 'leading the voice for private sector businesses in Downtown Denver' (https://www.downtowndenver.com/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Bell Policy Center
lean_basis: Self-described progressive group: it takes 'a progressive, research-focused approach to public policy change in Colorado' (https://bellpolicy.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Common Sense Institute Colorado
lean_basis: Research group that calls itself 'a leading voice for free enterprise' (https://commonsenseinstituteus.org/about/) and non-partisan. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Kim Monson Colorado Voter's Guide
lean_basis: Voter guide by Kim Monson (https://kimmonson.com/colorado-voter-guide/2026/county-denver/); the pages read state no mission, and its home page blocked automated reads. No outside rating found; lean kept pending a stated mission.

name: Official issue committees (registered campaigns for and against each measure)
lean_basis: Each committee is partisan for its own side; listed so voters can read the campaigns' own cases.
